quickStart.title: Get on the map in 2 minutes
quickStart.intro: Just the basics now. Photos and the rest can wait.
quickStart.nameHint: Customers see this. You don't need to use your real name.
quickStart.paymentHint: Only the type. Never put account names or numbers anywhere.
quickStart.done: You're set up! Now tap "I'm open" when you're ready.

live.stateReconnecting: Reconnecting… customers still see you for a few minutes
live.stateOffline: OFFLINE: you're not on the map
live.keepOpen: Keep this screen open while you're open. If you leave the app or lose signal for more than {{minutes}} minutes, you'll go offline on your own.
live.wentOfflineAuto: You went offline automatically because the app was closed or lost signal. Tap "I'm open" to go back on the map.
live.timerEnded: Your closing time arrived, so you're off the map. Tap "I'm open" to go back on.
live.offlinePending: No signal. You'll disappear from the map within {{minutes}} minutes, or as soon as you reconnect.
live.locationNeeded: To go live, StreetEats needs your location while the app is open. It's only shared while you're live and deleted when you close.
live.locationDenied: Location is off for StreetEats. Turn it on in Settings to go live.
live.vacationOn: Vacation mode is on, so you can't go live. Turn it off in My profile.
live.stateElsewhere: LIVE from another phone or browser
live.elsewhereBody: Your stand is on the map from another device. This one won't share its location unless you move the stand here.
live.locationUnavailable: We couldn't get your location. Check that location is on, then try again.
live.locationDeniedWeb: Your browser is blocking location for this site. Allow it in the site settings (next to the address bar), then try again.
live.keepOpenWeb: Keep this page open and on screen while you're open. If you switch away or lose signal for more than {{minutes}} minutes, you'll go offline on your own.
live.wentOfflineAutoWeb: You went offline automatically because this page was hidden or lost signal. Press "I'm open" to go back on the map.

menu.title: Menu
menu.name: Name
menu.empty: No items yet. Add what you sell so customers can find you.

settings.title: My profile
settings.descriptionPlaceholder: What makes your food or flowers special?
settings.contactHint: Off by default. Only add it if you want customers to reach you. Never required.
settings.vacationHint: Hide your page and stop going live until you turn this off.

web.signInNeeded: Sign in with your vendor account to manage your stand.
web.vendorsOnly: This page is for vendors. You're signed in with a customer account.

photos.title: Photos
photos.warning: Please no faces or license plates. We remove location and camera details from every photo.
photos.customerEmpty: No customer photos yet. They appear here after a moderator approves them.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.replyPlaceholder: Thank them, or explain what happened.
reviews.blockHint: Blocked people can't review you, add photos to your page or confirm you. Reviews they already wrote stay up unless a moderator removes them.
